canonical_name: Uncontrolled Software Installation on Operational Systems
description: Procedures and measures are not implemented to securely manage software installation on operational systems. This signal indicates that software can be installed on production systems without appropriate authorization, validation, testing, or security review processes.
applicability: Applicable to any operational system including production servers, workstations, cloud instances, containers, virtual machines, network devices, and embedded systems. Includes operating system packages, application software, libraries, dependencies, scripts, and firmware updates.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through analysis of software deployment policies, change management procedures, application control configurations, package manager policies, container image approval workflows, and endpoint management systems. May also be identified through review of privilege restrictions and installation audit logs.
